# Municipal Ordinance No. 002, Series of 2008

**An Ordinance Regulating the Use and Operation of Motorcycles within the Municipality of Pitogo, Quezon, Prescribing Penalties and Fines for Violations (Kautusang Bayan Blg. 002, Serye ng Taong 2008)**

## Summary

This ordinance comprehensively regulates the use and operation of motorcycles within the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], Quezon. It covers licensing and registration requirements, operational rules, parking regulations, speed limits, and penalties for violations. The ordinance applies to nine (9) barangays within the poblacion area: Brgy. Manggahan, Brgy. Masaya, Brgy. Mayubok, Brgy. Pamilihan, Brgy. Maaliw, Brgy. Castillo, Brgy. Pag-asa, Brgy. Dalampasiган, and Brgy. Dulong Bayan.

## Key Provisions

**Section 1 — Short Title.** Known as the "Kautusang Bayan sa Paggamit at Operasyon ng mga Motorsiklo sa Bayan ng Pitogo, Quezon 2008."

**Section 2 — Declaration of Policy.** Recognizes the need for regulation of motorcycle use to ensure public safety, peace, and orderly transportation.

**Section 3 — Definition of Terms.**
- (a) "Motorsiklo" — any two-wheeled motor vehicle
- (b) "Lisensya" — a license issued by the Land Transportation Office (LTO)
- (d) "May-ari" — the actual and legal owner or operator of the motorcycle
- (e) "Kalye" — any public road or street (private roads excluded)
- (f) "Himpil" — parking of motorcycle in any place where it may be left
- (g) "Minors" or "Minor de Edad" — persons below 17 years old
- (h) "Poblacion" — the nine (9) barangays within the town center

### Chapter I — Licensing and Registration

**Section 4.** All motorcycles must be registered with the Land Transportation Office and must have a license plate.

**Section 5.** It is prohibited for anyone to operate a motorcycle without a valid license. Drivers must carry their license at all times. Owners must present the license if requested by authorities.

**Section 6.** It is prohibited for minors (below 17 years old) to operate motorcycles.

### Chapter II — Operation of Motorcycles

**Section 7.** It is prohibited for anyone to operate a motorcycle under the influence of drugs or prohibited substances.

**Section 8.** Helmets are required for both the driver and the passenger.

**Section 9.** A maximum of two (2) passengers only may ride a motorcycle, including the driver and the passenger.

**Section 10.** Motorcycle operators must drive carefully to avoid excessive noise from mufflers and to maintain smooth and quiet operation.

**Section 11.** Excessive speed and reckless driving within the poblacion area is prohibited.

### Chapter III — Parking of Motorcycles

**Section 12.** Motorcycle parking is prohibited in the following areas:
- (a) In front of intersections
- (b) In front of private driveways
- (c) In front of fire station driveways
- (d) In areas marked as No Parking Area
- (e) Near curb lines
- (f) On the roadway side of any parked vehicle

**Section 13.** Parking or stopping of motorcycles on sidewalks, canals, or any road that obstructs the normal flow of traffic is prohibited.

### Chapter IV — Speed Limits

**Section 14.** Motorcycle operators must drive carefully and be mindful of the safety of pedestrians and other road users.

**Section 15.** Reckless or fast driving that may cause injury to persons or damage to property is prohibited.

**Section 16.** A speed limit of twenty kilometers per hour (20 kph) is imposed within the poblacion of Pitogo, Quezon.

### Chapter V — Penalties

**Section 17.** Any person found violating this ordinance shall be subject to the following penalties:
- (a) **First Offense** — fine of One Hundred Pesos (P 100.00)
- (b) **Second Offense** — fine of Two Hundred Pesos (P 200.00)
- (c) **Third and Subsequent Offenses** — fine of Five Hundred to One Thousand Pesos (P 500.00 - P 1,000.00) or imprisonment of one to two working days (1-2 days), at the discretion of the court

**Section 18.** Any person who refuses to acknowledge the penalty even for a first or second offense violation may be subjected to the punishment prescribed for third and subsequent offenses as stated in the ordinance.

### Chapter VI — Other Provisions

**Section 19.** The Municipal Mayor, Chief of Police, and all law enforcement officers are directed to implement and enforce this ordinance.

**Section 20.** The Municipal Treasurer is directed to collect all fines and penalties and issue corresponding official receipts.

**Section 21.** The Sangguniang Bayan Secretary is directed to furnish copies of the Municipal Citation Report/Ticket for use in implementing this ordinance.

**Section 22.** All motorcycle owners who have obtained licenses from the Land Transportation Office shall register at the Sangguniang Bayan within 48 hours of receipt of their license.

**Section 23.** Any matter not covered by this ordinance shall be governed by the provisions of RA 4136, otherwise known as the Land Transportation and Traffic Code.

**Section 24.** Any existing ordinance or provision that conflicts with this ordinance is hereby repealed.

**Section 25.** If any provision of this ordinance is declared unconstitutional or invalid, the remaining provisions shall not be affected.

**Section 26.** This ordinance shall take effect after publication as required by law, pursuant to [[Sec-511-RA7160|Section 511]] (a) of [[RA-7160|RA 7160]].
